name: rantine
description: Rantine (Fall from Heaven), a burly orc warlord: green skin, a dark brown mohawk with a grey streak, a scarred face with small tusks, a spiked steel pauldron on his right shoulder, an orange sash across a dark leather tunic, an orange loincloth, a steel knee guard, brown leather boots, a broad notched curved steel sword (falchion) held up in his LEFT hand (screen-right) and a round wooden shield with a steel rim and boss on his RIGHT arm (screen-left)
hands: the curved sword stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and the round wooden shield stays on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the curved sword is lifted up over the head with its notched tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the curved sword cocked behind the head with the broad blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the round wooden shield tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the broad curved blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the broad curved blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round wooden shield swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the curved blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the mohawk trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the curved sword lifts back toward the ready angle, the round wooden shield coming forward again

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, tusked jaw clenched, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the round wooden shield flung out to the left, the curved sword arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the curved sword dipping, the round wooden shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the curved sword arm flung up, the round wooden shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the curved sword lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the tip of the curved sword resting on the ground, the shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the curved sword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the curved sword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round wooden shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round wooden shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the curved sword and the round wooden shield on the ground beside him
